ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Visual Studio Code Tunnel Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects renamed Visual Studio Code tunnel execution. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel

sequences.query: (((process_original_file_name = "None" AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ tunnel$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ tunnel.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-accept\\-server\\-license\\-terms.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*tunnel\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*service.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*internal\\-run.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*tunnel\\-service\\\.log.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\code\\-tunnel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\code\\\.exe$")))) OR ((parent_process_command_line = RGX("\\ tunnel$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ \\/c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\servers\\\\Stable\\-.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*code\\-server\\\.cmd.*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\code\\-tunnel\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\code\\\.exe$"))))
